Distance is estimated from an approximate road-distance model, not a live traffic route. Trinidad ↔ Tobago routes are priced as a flat TT$65.00–$85.00 range. Routes beyond 140 km within Trinidad need a custom quote — get in touch and we'll confirm the exact rate. (Tobago is only about 41 km end to end, so every Tobago-only route falls within our standard bands.) This calculator gives an estimate only, not a binding invoice.
